loze / before Time

before Time

Property

The relation that obtains between an eventuality e and a period of time t if and only if e occurs entirely before t

https://loze-ontology.org/beforeTime

For example

WWII occurred before 1960, the birth of Napoleon occurred before 1800

Note

The relation obtains even if the eventuality does not occur right before the period of time: for example, WWII occurred before 1970, even though over two decades passed between the end of WWII and 1970

loze is a top-level ontology after E. J. Lowe's four-category ontology, with Zemach's schematic particulars. Every term here is identified by an IRI under https://loze-ontology.org/.
